predictions.instrument: Russian energy exports / Kremlin negotiation leverage
predictions.prediction_text: Russia negotiating energy-linked financial incentives with Qatar will soften Kremlin resistance to Western-led ceasefire frameworks.
predictions.expected_result: Within 3 months, Russian public or diplomatic statements will show increased willingness to engage with proposed Western ceasefire frameworks and at least one Russia-Qatar energy-financing agreement will be announced or advanced.

predictions.instrument: LNG export deals / European gas market
predictions.prediction_text: Washington’s push to lock in LNG export deals with Europe will face direct competition from a Qatari–Russian axis offering integrated financing and infrastructure support.
predictions.expected_result: Over the next 6 months, at least one planned U.S.-EU LNG agreement will be delayed, altered, or lose market share, and at least one new or expanded Qatar–Russia-backed LNG or gas infrastructure financing agreement affecting European supply will be announced.
